description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian stocks in an index gained or lost the most, or traded the most, in the latest end-of-day session.

Returns the stocks in an index ranked on their latest end-of-day quote. `metric` is "pct_change" (the day's percentage change, default), "change" (in rupees), "turnover" (rupees traded) or "volume" (shares traded). `direction` is "desc" (default: largest first) or "asc". `index` defaults to NIFTY 500; a name that is not recognised returns the valid ones. `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 20). The session cannot be chosen: the result's `as_of` says which one was ranked. To rank every NSE security on a past day use get_market_ranking.

index.description: Index name, e.g. "NIFTY 50" or "BSE SENSEX" (a name, not a slug).
index.title: Index

name: get_top_movers
title: Top gainers and losers
